feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 5 September 2026 10:24pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 05 September 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure will decline as frontal systems affect the Irish Sea overnight.


##Wind##

South 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 overnight in most waters, but 3 to 5 in the southeast of the area. Then veering west or southwest 4 or 5 in all waters early Sunday night.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building mainly moderate overnight but remaining slight in the southeast of the area.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain or drizzle at times.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, increasing southwest 5 or 6 Monday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but slight in the southeast of the area. Becoming slight in all waters overnight into Monday, then increasing moderate on Monday afternoon.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle at first and again later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
